links.comparator_used: Original author-written lay summaries (unsimplified research abstracts' existing lay summaries)
links.outcome: Readability (FKRE), factual accuracy, word count compliance, and composite high-quality rate
links.effect: Median FKRE extended prompt 47, simple prompt 36, original 20 (P<.001); median accuracy 5 for both AI vs 5 (IQR 4-5) for original (P<.001); wrong word count 19% extended, 20% simple vs 69% original (P<.001); high-quality 79.4% extended, 54.9% simple, 5.4% original (P<.001)
links.quote: The proportion rated as high-quality was 79.4% for the extended prompt, 54.9% for the simple prompt, and 5.4% for original summaries (P<.001).

links.comparator_used: Simple prompt based on the journal's guidelines (versus extended prompt refined to improve readability)
links.outcome: Readability (FKRE) and composite high-quality rate; accuracy and word count compliance
links.effect: Median FKRE 47 (IQR 42-56) extended vs 36 (IQR 29-43) simple (P<.001); high-quality 79.4% vs 54.9%; no significant difference in accuracy (P=.53) or word count compliance (P=.87)
links.quote: ChatGPT-4-generated lay summaries showed an improvement in readability compared to human-written versions, with the extended prompt achieving higher scores than the simple prompt (median FKRE: extended prompt 47, IQR 42-56; simple prompt 36, IQR 29-43; original 20, IQR 9.5-29; P<.001).
